prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity dark desktop portfolio landing-page direction comp, 1536 by 1024 landscape
Primary request: Design an unmistakably non-generic responsive website viewport for COLTON SPURGIN as a live dark suminagashi ink basin. The surface must remember where service, code, research, and curiosity have moved through it while the facts stay still and readable.
Scene/backdrop: no scene; flat front-facing dark website interface
Subject: a candid portfolio for an Air Force NCO, lead software developer intern, research assistant, and UWF senior specializing in AI graduating December 2026, who wants to build useful ambitious software and pursue a master’s degree
Style/medium: high-fidelity dark web UI with indigo and carbon fluid marbling, paper-white wakes, a restrained humanist sans, and one quiet stationary margin; technically extraordinary but calm
Composition/framing: seventy percent of the viewport is one continuous near-black fluid basin, not an image inside a box. A single indigo current begins at upper right and feathers diagonally toward lower left, carrying four labeled eddies: AIR FORCE NCO, LEAD SOFTWARE DEVELOPER INTERN, RESEARCH ASSISTANT, AI SPECIALIZATION · UWF · DEC 2026. A still vertical margin on the left contains COLTON SPURGIN, the large statement “MAKE THE HARD THING CLEAR. THEN BUILD IT.”, and WORK, EXPERIENCE, ABOUT, CONTACT. The lower still margin begins SELECTED WORK as four small dye drops labeled BORK, VELLM, TSP BENCHMARKS, HOME LAB. The newest drop near VIEW THE WORK is the darkest indigo region. Make the living current the single dominant move; the factual margin must stay crisp and stationary.
Color palette: abyss #030711, indigo depth #142b52, paper wake #d6dde9, current blue #335f9d, carbon #080a0e
Materials/textures: true fluid marbling, feathered ink rain, subtle wet sheen, crisp paper margin
Text (verbatim): “COLTON SPURGIN”; “WORK”; “EXPERIENCE”; “ABOUT”; “CONTACT”; “MAKE THE HARD THING CLEAR. THEN BUILD IT.”; “AIR FORCE NCO”; “LEAD SOFTWARE DEVELOPER INTERN”; “RESEARCH ASSISTANT”; “AI SPECIALIZATION · UWF · DEC 2026”; “SELECTED WORK”; “BORK”; “VELLM”; “TSP BENCHMARKS”; “HOME LAB”; “VIEW THE WORK”; “START A CONVERSATION”
Constraints: must read as a functional dark desktop website, not abstract art or a poster; preserve crisp semantic-looking text and navigation outside the fluid; no portrait, logo, invented metrics, employers, awards, testimonials, or project claims
Avoid: generic hero plus card grid, bento grid, beige editorial portfolio, cyberpunk neon, terminal UI, cockpit, military insignia, decorative particles, rounded cards, glassmorphism, 3D device mockup, browser chrome, illegible pseudo-text, watermark
